# baguetteBox.js

Version: **1.13.0**. License: MIT; the original license is included in `LICENSE`.

The JavaScript and CSS are copied unchanged from the release's `dist` directory:
[upstream release](https://github.com/feimosi/baguetteBox.js/releases/tag/v1.13.0).

The Fun page loads these local files directly. There is no build step or runtime dependency on a CDN.
To update, replace both distribution files and the license from a reviewed release, update this version,
then verify screenshot opening, keyboard controls, closing, and game links in a browser.
